title: Static current-KL 65k-to-262k multi-seed scale
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The mechanically stable static KL(current||initial Standard10) lineages will retain positive geometric multi-anchor slopes when continued from about 65k to about 262k cumulative physical hands across at least two of three seeds without catastrophic source-policy drift.
material_change: Exact-state continuation of the three admitted static current-KL lineages only; preserve optimizer, serialized complete-hand replay, loss-K-best pool, adaptive league, assignment RNG/evidence, run IDs, and initial Standard10 reference while moving to disjoint fixed-deal ranges.
baseline: Frozen 65k static endpoints from v6-nashpg-moving-reference-geometric-20260903; all three had positive 16k-to-65k pooled slopes and low Standard10 drift.
notes: No moving-reference arm and no Slumbot calls. This scale decision follows replicated static slopes and explicitly does not treat 65k absolute strength as a benchmark gate.

Parent SHA256s and staged metric/assignment prefix SHA256s are pinned in the launcher. Existing scale-resume preflight will independently replay assignment RNG and verify optimizer, serialized replay, pool, adaptive league, counters, and nonoverlapping deal windows before training.

Seed1 exact continuation completed naturally at 264,945 cumulative physical hands (198,955 new), transition marker 226,348, iteration55. No reset, replay recovery, KL stop, NaN, or ratio breach; seed2 exact continuation started.

Seed2 exact continuation completed naturally at 262,859 cumulative physical hands (192,994 new), transition marker 230,498, iteration56. No reset, replay recovery, KL stop, NaN, or ratio breach; seed3 exact continuation started.

Seed1 and Seed2 exact-state continuations finished naturally at 264945 and 262859 cumulative physical hands; generic read-only audits pass all gates. Seed3 remains in the original uninterrupted launcher session. Frozen evaluation and aggregate tooling were fixed before observing endpoints and refuse overwrite.

Seed3 completed naturally in the original uninterrupted launcher session at 267202 cumulative physical hands (201381 new), transition marker 230610, iteration56. All three lineages are frozen; total new environment hands 593330 and cumulative physical hands 795006. No Slumbot calls.

Training audit initially surfaced candidate ID reuse on seed2/3 because OpponentPool.load_from_checkpoint derives next_id only from active snapshots, not rejected candidate history. Read-only causal audit showed all reused IDs previously belonged only to rejected candidates, active IDs were unique at every assignment, and full (snapshot_id, snapshot_iteration, snapshot_hands) refs remained globally unique and hash-bound. The issue is recorded as a future provenance repair, while all causal mechanics, exact prefixes, accounting, and session-independence gates pass 3/3.
Post-finish experiment-log validation passed 324 records; audit since experiment start found 1 record and 0 warnings.

result.summary: Three exact-state static current-KL lineages added 593330 physical environment hands and reached 264945, 262859, and 267202 cumulative hands. Across 98304 untouched multi-anchor evaluation hands, 65k-to-262k slopes were -2.753, +0.994, and +5.586 bb/100; combined +1.276 with raw 95% CI [-2.231,+4.783]. All 60k outcome-blind drift states were safe.
result.conclusion: Mechanics and evidence integrity passed, with a documented noncausal candidate-ID reuse provenance limitation on seed2/3. Two of three slopes and the median were positive, but only seed3 met both-seat and three-anchor breadth simultaneously; seed1 alone showed broad collapse. This is mixed, underpowered evidence, not replicated mechanism failure and not sufficient for preregistered promotion.
result.next_step: Repair OpponentPool resume next_id provenance first, then run an independent fresh-only higher-precision matched confirmation of the same frozen 65k-to-262k endpoints before deciding whether to scale selected lineages toward 1M. Do not call Slumbot from this result.
